map.输入支出乘数 k，按 MPC=1−1/k 反推边际消费倾向，用于宏观经济学中乘数: Enter the expenditure multiplier k to derive the marginal propensity to consume by MPC = 1 - 1/k, for teaching multiplier effects and consumption behavior in macroeconomics.
map.输入支出乘数 k，求边际消费倾向。: Enter the expenditure multiplier k to get the marginal propensity to consume.
map.反推 MPC：录入支出乘数 k，算 MPC。: Back-derive MPC: enter the expenditure multiplier k to get MPC.
map.政策评估：由测算的乘数估财政刺激的消费传导。: Policy evaluation: estimate the consumption pass-through of fiscal stimulus from the computed multiplier.
map.教学演示：演示 k 越大 MPC 越接近 1。: Teaching demo: show that the larger k is, the closer MPC gets to 1.
map.：示例：支出乘数 k=5，MPC=1−1/5=0.8。: : example: expenditure multiplier k = 5 gives MPC = 1 - 1/5 = 0.8.

map.由 k=1/(1−MPC) 变形得 MPC=1−1/k，要求 k>1。结果仅作经: MPC = 1 - 1/k derived from k = 1/(1 - MPC), requiring k > 1. map.税收乘数=−MPC/(1−MPC)，与政府支出乘数符号相反、量级略小。结果仅作经: The tax multiplier = -MPC/(1 - MPC), opposite in sign to the government spending multiplier and slightly smaller in magnitude. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only, and do not constitute investment advice or a policy basis; parts involving forecasting and empirical estimation defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
